title: General Application
description:
Euclid: Where Projects Take Shape
At Euclid, we’re on a mission to accelerate the world’s transition to renewable energy so that we can decarbonize the planet as fast as possible. We empower renewable energy teams to accomplish in days what typically takes weeks.
We care about doing meaningful work, delivering real value and results to our customers. We’re passionate about solving real problems by focusing on what truly matters. We’re passionate about our work, and we’re building products and services that our customers genuinely love and trust. We’re not afraid to think big and be bold, as we’re building not only a future we believe in but a workplace culture that we’re proud to be a part of.
---
We're Always Looking for Great People
This isn't a specific open role. But if you're excited about what we are working on and think your background could be a fit somewhere at Euclid, we'd love to hear from you!
Submit your resume and a short note on what kind of work you're looking for. That context helps us make sure your application gets to the right person when something opens up.
We review applications on a rolling basis and will reach out if there's a match. We can't always guarantee a quick turnaround, but we do read everything that comes in.

---
We are committed to building an inclusive working environment and doing our part to create a more equitable world. We strongly encourage applicants from underrepresented and/or historically marginalized communities to apply.
To learn more about Euclid, our values and our interview process, please visit Interviewing @ Euclid .

title: Director, Euclid Blue
description:
Euclid: Where Projects Take Shape
At Euclid, we’re on a mission to accelerate the world’s transition to renewable energy so that we can decarbonize the planet as fast as possible. We empower renewable energy teams to accomplish in days what typically takes weeks.
We care about doing meaningful work, delivering real value and results to our customers. We’re passionate about solving real problems by focusing on what truly matters. We’re passionate about our work, and we’re building products and services that our customers genuinely love and trust. We’re not afraid to think big and be bold, as we’re building not only a future we believe in but a workplace culture that we’re proud to be a part of.
---
About the Role
Euclid is hiring a Director to lead our Blue service line, our highest-complexity, most relationship-intensive client engagements. Blue clients aren't buying discrete deliverables; they're buying a trusted operational partner who can sit inside their portfolio and own outcomes across multiple work-streams. The Blue Director makes that possible at scale. You'll directly manage and develop our Program Executive team, build the operational infrastructure that makes Blue repeatable, and serve as the senior relationship holder and strategic partner on our most deeply embedded accounts. This is a people leader, operational builder, and trusted client advisor in one seat, not a role for someone who wants to stay in the weeds of a single engagement, but for someone who can hold the whole system together and make everyone around them better.
What You'll Do
Serve as senior client partner and support business development

- Hold the senior relationship on major Blue accounts, the person clients call not just when something goes wrong, but when thinking through major portfolio decisions and next steps

- Act as a genuine strategic partner to Blue clients: fluent in portfolio development, project CapEx/OpEx financial drivers, acquisition strategy, engineering/construction risk, and financing structures

- Work alongside Sales and account managers on Blue pipeline, providing the deal-level credibility and executive presence that brings sophisticated clients across the line

- Support proposal development for complex Blue scopes

- Coach Program Executives through difficult client situations in real time

Lead and develop the Program Executive team

- Serve as the 'Head Coach' for engagement strategy, enabling your team to drive strategic decisions with the client, while helping to 'call plays' within the engagement as needed

- Directly manage and develop Euclid's Program Executives—the senior individuals who run Blue engagements day-to-day

- Hire, develop internally, and onboard Program Executives as Blue scales

- Drive performance management with structured input from clients and cross-vertical stakeholders

- Build and own the career path and growth model for the Program Executive role

- Mentor the team in Client management best practices, serving as overhead coverage with Clients, but enabling them to own the relationships day to day.

Build the operational foundation for Blue

- Define and enforce engagement kickoff standards—how a Blue engagement gets stood up across multiple verticals

- Establish cross-vertical handoff protocols so projects move between stages without losing context

- Set client reporting standards that reflect Blue's proactive, ownership-oriented communication posture

- Develop knowledge capture standards that make engagements transferable and institutional

- Co-develop Blue overlay frameworks with vertical Program Managers—the operational infrastructure that enhances discrete vertical SOPs and offerings with the stage continuity and depth of ownership required for Blue engagements.

- Ensure Program Executives operate within established standards when appropriate rather than improvising

Own resource governance across Blue

- Run regular capacity planning touch-points with vertical Directors and Program Managers

- Lead the staffing agreement process at engagement kickoff

- Review escalations for within-vertical Blue engagements approaching the Program Executive threshold

- Resolve resourcing conflicts when Blue needs compete with vertical workloads

- Evolve and strengthen cross-functional staffing strategies to ensure Blue engagements leverage the most appropriate tools and talent from across Services.

Who You Are

- Deep fluency in utility-scale solar/BESS (DG/C&I preferred in addition) at the deal level. You've been close to portfolio development decisions, capital deployment, acquisitions/dispositions, or project finance at a developer, IPP, or advisory firm

- Client presence that goes beyond delivery. Clients want to call you for strategic perspective, not just when something goes wrong

- Your instinct is to help clients think through decisions, not to sell them something

- You've run or been close to complex, multi-workstream programs and know what it takes to hold them together

- Proven manager who has developed senior individual contributors, with the coaching instincts to match

- You've built systems and processes, not just delivered projects

- You can negotiate resource commitments across peer teams without creating adversarial dynamics

- Working knowledge of Development and/or Engineering & Construction is a strong plus

- Background at a services firm delivering managed services or owner's rep programs is a strong plus

- Experience leading a team through a significant structural or cultural transition is a strong plus

Why You'll Love Working With Us

- ⌨️ Remote work, forever!

- 🪄 Competitive benchmarked compensation

- 🩺 Health and retirement benefits

- 🌴 Flexible time off

- 🚀 Exciting, mission-driven work that has impact

- 💪🏽 Regular company off-sites

How You'll Be Compensated
The starting base salary for this role is between $300,000 and $350,000 with equity and a performance-based bonus included as part of total compensation. Your actual offer may vary based on factors such as location, experience, and internal benchmarks. We're committed to fair and equitable compensation and regularly review our approach to ensure alignment with performance and market standards.
---

title: Project Manager, Tax Credit Compliance
description:
Euclid: Where Projects Take Shape
At Euclid, we’re on a mission to accelerate the world’s transition to renewable energy so that we can decarbonize the planet as fast as possible. We empower renewable energy teams to accomplish in days what typically takes weeks.
We care about doing meaningful work, delivering real value and results to our customers. We’re passionate about solving real problems by focusing on what truly matters. We’re passionate about our work, and we’re building products and services that our customers genuinely love and trust. We’re not afraid to think big and be bold, as we’re building not only a future we believe in but a workplace culture that we’re proud to be a part of.
---
Euclid is hiring a Project Manager to support and execute our Tax Credit Compliance (TCC) service line, working directly under our Program Director of TCC. You'll serve as the Engagement Lead for our Prohibited Foreign Entity (PFE), Domestic Content (DC), and Prevailing Wage & Apprenticeship (PWA) engagements — managing project timelines, coordinating supplier and contractor diligence, building audit-ready documentation, and keeping complex multi-stakeholder projects moving. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who has a strong analytical foundation, thrives on process and detail, and wants to build deep expertise in IRA tax credit compliance at a fast-moving company.
What You'll Do
Execute TCC engagements

- Manage day-to-day delivery of PFE, DC, and PWA diligence projects

- Coordinate EPC, contractor, and supplier onboarding, certification collection, and supply chain mapping

- Provide oversight and QA/QC of PWA compliance data, resolving discrepancies in certified payroll and apprenticeship records to minimize risk of correction payments or IRS penalties

- Support Material Assistance Cost Ratio (MACR) analysis and threshold testing

- Compile and maintain audit-ready documentation packages

Drive project operations

- Own project timelines, trackers, and client-facing status updates

- Coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders (clients, suppliers, EPC contractors, counsel, and lenders) to keep deliverables on track

- Lead client engagements end-to-end, owning the relationship, timeline, and deliverables, while proactively identifying and resolving issues and risks before they impact scope, schedule, or client trust

Support framework and tooling development

- Help maintain and improve standardized workflows for EPC, contractor, and supplier onboarding, cost attribution, and reporting

- Assist with implementing AI-enabled tools for document ingestion, MACR calculations, and supplier risk scoring

- Contribute to processes and templates that make delivery more consistent and scalable

Contribute to business development support

- Assist with proposals, data room prep, and client onboarding materials

- Help prepare client-facing deliverables and presentation materials

Collaborate cross-functionally

- Work closely with other program managers and service line teams

- Surface opportunities to improve shared tools and processes across the broader services team

Who You Are

- 3-6 years of experience in tax, project finance, renewable energy, supply chain compliance, consulting, or a related field

- Exposure to IRA credits (45Y, 48E, 45X), Domestic Content, PWA, or PFE frameworks is a plus—but we'll train the right person

- Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with cost models, supplier data, and legal/technical documentation

- Highly organized with sharp attention to detail—you keep projects on track and nothing falls through the cracks

- Clear communicator who can synthesize complex information and keep stakeholders aligned

- Self-starter who takes initiative and doesn't wait to be told what to do next

- Collaborative and low-ego; you're energized by being part of a small, high-output team

Nice-to-Have

- Experience at a Big 4 firm, law firm, renewable developer, or project finance shop

- Familiarity with supply chain or sanctions compliance

- Exposure to AI / data tools in diligence or document workflows

Why Euclid

- Category Creation: Help build a new market segment from the ground up

- Software + Services Model: Work at the intersection of advisory and technology

- High Impact: Your work directly supports billions in tax credit deployment

- Learning Curve: Accelerated growth working directly with senior leaders and domain experts

- Growth Path: Clear trajectory toward senior practitioner or engagement lead roles

Why You'll Love Working With Us

- ⌨️ Remote work, forever!

- 🪄 Competitive benchmarked compensation

- 🩺 Health and retirement benefits

- 🌴 Flexible time off

- 🚀 Mission-driven work with real market impact

- 💪🏽 Regular company off-sites
